training_only_exclusion.reason: official object has zero positive primitive rows under the frozen point-to-primitive mapping, so class-conditional primitive BCE/ranking is undefined

causal_conclusion.what_worked: The head remains directionally responsive to additional negative clicks on every held-out scene, and the fixed all-fit click-response gate passes narrowly.
causal_conclusion.what_failed: Absolute likelihood calibration fails badly: v3 assigns about 0.46-0.48 foreground probability mass on every scene while targets occupy only 0.012-0.056, producing high recall and very low precision.
causal_conclusion.first_principles_cause: The scene-centered cosine is stored as (cosine+1)/2. Under an additive positive LLR, the query-free/null cosine near zero becomes a positive affinity near 0.5, so a single positive click adds a large scene-wide foreground offset. Analytic class-prior removal cannot remove this evidence-coordinate offset; it only removes the empirical label prevalence intercept.
causal_conclusion.not_the_cause: The exact solver-link repair is not responsible for this source-gate failure because source gates evaluate raw q through fixed continuous Gaussian readout before graph/solver inference.
causal_conclusion.next_methodic_requirement: A future variant must define a signed, null-centered evidence ratio or positive-versus-negative contrast before the monotone LLR, with a query-free null mapped to zero evidence. It must be newly preregistered and pass source gates; v3 must not be retuned on scene0003.

implementation_repairs.gaussian_click_mixture: Replaced exp-domain normalization with mathematically equivalent log-space softmax after a valid scene0002 click underflowed to all zero.
implementation_repairs.direct_likelihood_solver_interface: Compiles PrimitiveUnaryEvidence(q,c) as T*logit((1-c)*0.5+c*q), so solver sigmoid(unary/T) exactly preserves the effective likelihood instead of applying a second lossy sigmoid to signed purity.
